name: Centro (Pueblo)
tagline: Town center around the main square
description: The walkable town heart around the zocalo and San Joaquin fort, with taquerias, shops, banks and the church. It offers the most affordable lodging, everyday services and a short stroll down to the lagoon viewpoints.
bestFor: Budget nomads wanting walkable town services and cheaper stays

name: Costera (Lagoon Waterfront)
description: The road hugging the western shore of the Laguna de Bacalar, lined with boutique hotels, cenotes and swim docks. Staying here means direct access to the famous seven-color lagoon, kayaking and sunrise views over the water.
bestFor: Travellers wanting direct lagoon access, swimming and boutique waterfront stays

name: Barrio Magisterial / North Town
description: A calmer residential zone north of the plaza with local homes, small guesthouses and rentals. It suits longer stays wanting a quieter base within cycling or walking distance of both the center and lagoon access points.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting a calm local base close to town and lagoon

name: Los Rapidos (South Lagoon)
description: The southern end of the lagoon near the Rapidos channel and stromatolites, several kilometers from town. It offers secluded eco-lodges, clear water and quiet nature, best for travellers with transport who want isolation over convenience.
bestFor: Nature seekers with transport wanting a secluded southern lagoon retreat
